notes: Hermes' `hermes chat` REPL is one persistent process across both turns, so the daemon's PID-liveness branch (pid_manager.go:1026) is what keeps the store session alive past readyTTL. Recording uses IRRLICHT_READY_SESSION_TTL=15s so duration_at_least_ms=15000 cleanly exceeds it; if PID binding or the liveness check regresses, the session is deleted by the pid==0 arm (pid_manager.go:1029) and idle_window fails on its transcript_removed invariant. session_birth is left UNPINNED because a proc-<pid> pre-session precedes the store row (which is only INSERTed on the first user message) and because the shared store may surface unrelated historical sessions at daemon start; every phase from first_turn_start on is pinned with same_session_as, so the assertion 'the SAME session survived the idle window' is carried by the pinned chain, not by the birth. UPDATE (record, 2026-08-02): observations.cost_nonzero and observations.tokens_nonzero REMOVED — unsatisfiable on this column — while `model` and `agent` stay pinned and verify green. `of verify` hard-asserts only against the newest recording's replay-golden `summary`, which the offline replay tool builds by driving core/pkg/tailer with hermes.Parser, and that Parser sets ONLY ev.ModelName. Hermes' tokens live on the `sessions` AGGREGATE row and reach irrlicht solely through ComputeMetrics, a path replay never runs; the store-derived token lift in tools/onboarding-factory/cmd/replay/metrics.go is gated to antigravity. So the recipe verify line "the session's metrics carry model=gpt-5.6-luna with nonzero tokens and nonzero estimated cost" is only half reachable: the model half is asserted here, the token/cost half is not observable through replay. A prior run on this column saw the pins red directly (✗ cost_usd: want >0 got 0, ✗ tokens: want >0 got 0) with all state phases green. Same removal, same reason, as the committed 2-1_basic-turn and 1-1_session-start cells.
